title: Reverse Word Order
statement:
Return the words of a sentence in the opposite order.

Contract
- `text` is non-null and may be empty.
- Words are maximal runs of non-space characters separated by one or more space characters.
- Ignore leading and trailing spaces, and join the reversed words with exactly one space.
- Return an empty string when there are no words.

Examples
- `reverseWords("time to code")` returns `"code to time"`.
- `reverseWords("  hello   world  ")` returns `"world hello"`.
- `reverseWords("solo")` returns `"solo"`.
hints: Trim away outer spaces before splitting into words.
Scan from the end and append each word as you encounter it.
Avoid preserving the original spacing; the output has exactly one space between words. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space for the returned string.
inputSyntax: Input: a sentence, for example: time to code
